data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'deal' meaning valley and 'hlāf' meaning ruler or leader. Dallon is a strong, powerful name for a boy, evoking images of leadership and strength. The name Dallon carries the meaning “Ruler of the valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dallon usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine presence within, guiding and ruling over one's inner world.
data.etymology: Dallon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the valley.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dallon total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Dallon has a rich cultural history rooted in Old English language. The name's meanings suggest a leader or ruler of a valley, which can be a powerful and evocative image. In Celtic mythology, valleys are often seen as places of transformation and renewal. Thus, Dallon may be seen as a symbol of someone who can effectively lead and guide individuals through periods of growth and change.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dallon can be seen as a reminder of God's leadership and guidance in our lives. Just as a valley can be a place of transformation, so too can our spiritual journey be a process of growth and renewal. The name Dallon can serve as a reminder of the importance of trusting in God's leadership and seeking His guidance in all aspects of our lives.
